_why: Dotted paths (list indexes as numbers) that may differ from goldens/wire.json (the runner-to-broker wire: by_cell, direct, verbs), keyed wire. Each entry names one exact path; a wildcard is refused. Empty: no difference is allowed. A PR that changes the wire on purpose names each path it changes here; the edit is reviewed with the PR, and the integrity job (bin/goldens/golden-integrity.py) holds the committed goldens to the merge-base tree's behaviour everywhere else, fails on an entry that explains no difference or that the merge-base already carried, and on the push to main fails until a merged change's entries are cleared. Broker clients send UTF-8 (wave 2, B1): every client frames its request with the one encoder, shared/broker_socket.py encode(), which writes non-ASCII text as UTF-8 instead of \uXXXX escapes. The broker json.loads the line's bytes, so each request decodes to the value it decoded to before (bin/tests/test_broker_socket_wire.py runs the old and the new encoder over non-ASCII payloads). This file records decoded values, so no path here differs; the changed wire bytes are named in bin/goldens/allowed-seat-config-callers.json. #4011 (2026-11-13): the records and medchron ledgers gain reply_sent_at and reply_key (the reply-once mark, a defect Phase A pinned), so a records job row the broker returns carries both, null until replied.
